generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal
The tender is of two cover system.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT
The rates uploaded in the e procurement portal are exclusive of GST and GST will be paid separately
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd:26.04.2022
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (PCM-1), KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).

Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement in Karnataka Power Corporation Limited may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the Last date of submission of bid
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to be submitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority.

Contract Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to furnish e-Bank Guarantee from the banks which are integrated with NeSL or DD/NEFT from Nationalised/Scheduled Bank for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract value with an appropriate validity period within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of intent (LOI). The e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG)/DD shall be furnished in the prescribed format only. The work Performance shall be of 12 Months after completing the work. The total contract period is 15 Months. The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract. Bids with stipulation for settlement of disputes by reference to arbitration are not acceptable.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (At least 90% of the Contract value) as a prime contractor in at least One Civil work of value not less than Rs.12.5 Lakhs of in the last Five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27

Financial Turnover: The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in At least Two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs. 25.00 Lakhs during the last five completed financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit the certified copy of Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

Tender capacity (A x N x 2.5 - B) where A- Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N -Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 0.25 years. B- Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next (3 Months) 0.25 year period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited and should upload self-declaration stating that the mentioned turnover of our firm is obtained by execution of works only.

The Bidders should upload the following declarations duly signed . I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL/KPWD or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. II. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL/KPWD or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. III. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. IV. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. V. I/we shall pay fair and prevailing wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. VI. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Reconstruction of damaged wall and providing hand rails with chain-link fencing & tarpaulin sheet for forebay channel 2 at RTPS (Phase-II)

itemList.description: Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of serviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead Dismantling Brick / Tile work By Manual Means In cement mortar

Dismantling of barbed wire fencing/ wire mesh fencing including posts, foundation concrete, back filling of pit by manual means including disposal of dismantled material with all lifts and lead, stacking serviceable material and unserviceable material separately.

Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete,wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead Steel Work in all types of sections upto a height of 5 m above plinth level excluding cutting of rivet.Excluding dismembering

Providing and constructing load bearing wall with Solid Concrete blocks of size 400x150x200mm having block density more than 1800kg/m3 and minimum compressive strength of 4.00 N/mm2 conforming to IS 2185 (Part - I) - 2005 and constructed with CM 1:4 as per IS 2572:2005 including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and curing, usage charges of machinery etc complete as per specifications.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates.

Providing 12 mm cement plaster with cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) to brick masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work in single section, fixed with or without connecting plate, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge
Providing and fixing expansion hold fasteners on C.C. /R.C.C./Brick masonry surface backing including drilling necessary holes and the cost of bolt etc complete.Fastener with threaded dia 10 mm.

Providing and fixing G.I. chain link fabric fencing of required width in mesh size 50x50 mm including strengthening with 2 mm dia wire or nuts, bolts and washers as required complete as per the direction of Engineerin- charge. (Made of G.I. wire of dia. 4 mm, PVC coated to achieve outer dia not less than 5 mm in required colour and shade)

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign atter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing tarpaulin dust protection/temperature reduction shade net of 150 GSM to handrails of forebay including stitching, binding with UV stabilized nylon rope, clamps, nut bolts, fastening arrangements, overlaps, cutting, wastage, labour, scaffolding, transportation, loading/unloading complete as directed by Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work riveted, bolted or welded in built up sections, trusses and framed work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in- Charge.

Providing and fixing Nylon bird net 10mm x 10mm, binding with 2mm GI wire, clamps, nut bolts, fastening arrangements, overlaps, cutting, wastage, labour, scaffolding, transportation, loading/unloading complete as directed by Engineer-in-Charge.
